## Report Issue

Note: please [update ComfyUI](https://docs.comfy.org/zh-CN/installation/update_comfyui) first and prepare required models. Desktop/Cloud ship stable builds; nightly-supported models may not be included yet, please wait for the next stable release.

- Cannot run / runtime errors: [ComfyUI/issues](https://github.com/comfyanonymous/ComfyUI/issues)
- UI / frontend issues: [ComfyUI_frontend/issues](https://github.com/Comfy-Org/ComfyUI_frontend/issues)
- Workflow issues: [workflow_templates/issues](https://github.com/Comfy-Org/workflow_templates/issues)

nodes.title: KSampler settings
widgets_values:
You can test and find the best setting by yourself. The following table is for reference.
|   | Qwen | Comfy | lightning LoRA |
|--------|---------|------------|---------------------------|
| Steps  | 40      | 20         | 4                         |
| CFG    | 4.0     | 4.0       | 1.0                       |

By default, we use 20 steps as we just don't want it to take too long. Try 40 if you want a better result, but it will take longer.
The "Edit Model Reference Method" nodes above are not needed if you use Comfy files, but may be needed if you use repackaged ones from other people.

1. 换衣服： 图1的人物穿着图2的衣服
2. 换背景 (人物图片不要包含背景)：去掉图2中原有的人物， 把图1人物融入图2的环境和背景中，保证人物和环境完美融合，整体的光线统一
2.1 换背景 ： 参考图2， 替换图1的背景
3. 换肤色： 参考图2的女孩肤色，把图1女孩的皮肤稍微变白一点，但不要过曝，和周边环境完美融合
4. 大胸： 胸部再大一点，穿着有领口的衣服，扣子全部扣紧
5. 换脸：参考图2女孩脸部，让图1女孩脸部更清晰
图1女孩脸部换成图2里的女孩脸部，嘴巴微微有一点张开
